training.state: zone and time bin; shared table across vehicles
training.actions: stay or adjacent zone; only idle vehicles reposition
training.reward: pickup +1, completed +2, pickup travel -0.05; simplified credit assignment

compact.model: L2 linear regression, seasonal + zone features

commuter.model: L2 linear regression, seasonal + zone features

distributed.model: L2 linear regression, seasonal + zone features

limitations: No observed operational dataset was used.
Three stylized grids, not calibrated named cities.
Parameter-shared tabular Q-learning is exploratory, not deep multi-agent RL.
Reward approximates service; learned policy may underperform nearest baseline.
No road congestion, charging, battery or autonomous control model.
Reported scenario metrics average three seeds; traces show seed 7 only.
Forecast is evaluated on held-out synthetic seeds, not a real-city benchmark.
